Quantum 1.30.0 was certified on 2026-09-10. It pins **nucleus v1.26.0**, **quark v1.13.0** and **orbit v1.9.4**, with 23 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.29.0: nucleus goes from v1.25.0 to v1.26.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.12.0 to v1.13.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.9.3 to v1.9.4 (patch). 22 sibling modules change version.
